name: matlab-design-radar-waveform
description: Design, select, and analyze waveforms for radar, sonar, and active sensing using the Phased Array System Toolbox. Covers LFM, NLFM, FMCW, phase-coded, CW, stepped FM, custom IQ, ambiguity functions, sidelobe reduction, and Doppler tolerance. Key objects: phased.LinearFMWaveform, phased.NonlinearFMWaveform, phased.CustomFMWaveform, phased.PhaseCodedWaveform, phased.FMCWWaveform, phased.SteppedFMWaveform, phased.MFSKWaveform, phased.RectangularWaveform, nlfmspec2freq, shapespectrum, ambgfun, pambgfun, sidelobelevel, legendreseq, mlseq, radarWaveformGenerator.
